query: I have an 82‑year‑old man. For men 77–87 admitted with primary upper GI bleeding, what's the SD of LOS (days)?
final_sql: SELECT stddev(icustays.los) AS standard_deviation FROM patients JOIN admissions ON patients.subject_id = admissions.subject_id JOIN icustays ON admissions.stay_id = icustays.stay_id WHERE patients.gender = 'M' AND patients.anchor_year = 82 AND admissions.admission_type = 'primary upper GI bleeding' AND (patients.anchor_year_group::integer BETWEEN 77 AND 87);
